Each session starts with an empty window; only the program can save the status outside it and load it into the next window. Option a shows M4 (the window persists), b shows M2 (the model learns from chats), d shows the idea that the model can rewrite its own persistent instructions.

items.rationale: Error codes carry little meaning, so meaning-based (embedding) search can rank them poorly; keyword search matches the string itself.
